subject: Request: Short-term trial ramp + engineering recovery window
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@glowpay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial ramp + short engineering recovery window?

Hi Evelyn / Marissa —

Quick update from our side: we started end-to-end testing this week and ran into an unexpected webhook schema mismatch with one of our payment partners. Our engineers are tracking it down but it looks like the fix will take longer than anticipated because it requires a small SDK bump and a coordinated deploy on their side.

Because this affects our demo cadence, we’re at risk of missing the scheduled pilot demo next Friday. The team can keep iterating in a sandbox but we’ll need more tokens and a short extension on the trial window to prove the end-to-end flow once the partner patch lands.

Ask: would Redwood consider a temporary trial ramp (15k tokens) and a 2-week extension to our sandbox window so we can finish full integration and rerun the demo?

I’ve attached an error snippet and a short summary of the blocker for context. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful — Marco (cc) will be on the engineering side.

Thanks for considering,
Alicia Gomez
Director, Integrations — GlowPay
attachments: error_log_snippet.txt
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@glowpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ramp + short engineering recovery window?

Alicia — thanks for the clear summary and the error snippet. Sorry to hear the partner SDK bump introduced the delay.

I’m looping in Ben from Sales to evaluate a promotional uplift and Marissa from CS to coordinate the post-fix validation plan so we don’t lose demo momentum. Two quick asks from our side so we can turn fast:
- Can Marco share an ETA on the partner patch and a short checklist of the validation steps (ideally 3 bullets)?
- Can you confirm whether you need a tokens uplift only or also an absolute trial end-date extension?

If it’s helpful I can authorize a provisional uplift pending Ben’s signoff; Marissa, can you draft a condensed mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the uplift to completion criteria? I’ll attach a template — would prefer a focused list (deploy, smoke test, demo run).

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.inference | (415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@glowpay.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ramp + short engineering recovery window?

Alicia / team — appreciate the details. After a quick review I can approve a conditional promotional uplift. Proposed terms:
- 12,000 promotional tokens applied to your sandbox account immediately
- 14-day extension to the trial window starting from the date we confirm the partner deploy is complete
- Completion criteria: 1) partner deploy verified; 2) successful smoke test (5 end-to-end flows); 3) demo rehearsal with CS present

I’ve attached a short MAP template and the promo terms. If those work I’ll issue the uplift in our billing system and send a DocuSign for the promo terms (standard approval). Note: we can make the uplift immediate but we’ll require the MAP signed-off by Marissa to avoid open-ended credit usage.

Attachments: MAP_GlowPay_Q1.xlsx, promo_terms.pdf

—Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@glowpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@glowpay.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ramp + short engineering recovery window?

Thanks Ben — that sounds reasonable and fair.

We’ll:
- Have Marco send a short checklist & ETA by end of day (target deploy Thurs next week)
- Marissa will draft the MAP and return it within 24 hours
- I’ll sign the DocuSign once it arrives and confirm the rehearsal slot for the demo week
